<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def seg(frame):
    d={}
    for n in frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in 'OSYN' and n['pixels']>=5:
            px=n['pixels']; b=n['boundary']
            d[c]=(px, min(r for r,_ in b), max(r for r,_ in b), min(_ for _,_ in b) and min(c2 for _,c2 in b), max(c2 for _,c2 in b))
    return d
def redpix(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.splitlines()
    return sorted([(i,j) for i in range(0,52) for j,c in enumerate(a[i]) if c=='r'])
print("before:", seg(current_frame))
print("dot:", redpix(current_frame))
# probe O-left
res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':57,'col':6}], intent='explore')
print("after O-left:", seg(current_frame))
print("dot:", redpix(current_frame))
print("bc=",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),"ni=",last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
